ownRole: independent QA only, no role flip
requirements: Duplicate keys and unknown fields at every level rejected before typed constructors or filesystem
Strict bool-vs-int and upperbounds for epochs/PIDs/identities/counts; canonical path, no arbitrary alias
All3DB identities distinct same device, previous epoch/instance consistent across retained and original expectations
Codec result is data not proof of namespace/seccomp/mount/current UID
Reject stale/different PID if designed for same-process exec; do not turn spawn into same-PID acceptance
Malformed/truncated/oversize/nonfinite/deep JSON cannot partially construct stores or learn expectations from DB
Unknown/provided callbacks/modules/classnames/paths cannot turn into code execution
Original same source manifest/lease/cold/live gates stay unchanged after decode
Original typed values preserved; dictionaries do not independently create supervisor authority
